newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-EMERSON BACK AT THE RIVERSIDE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EMERSON BACK AT THE RIVERSIDE.

text.p: Middlesbrough manager Bryan Robson said on Tuesday that Brazilian midfielder Emerson would remain with the club despite returning to England on Saturday 72 hours late from his holiday in Brazil.
Emerson trained with the rest of the team at the Riverside Stadium on Tuesday and Robson said later: "Emo is staying at the club. It is as simple at that.
"There are teething problems and that sort of thing but we will help the player. Emo is going nowhere. That's the last thing I will say about it."

Robson, whose side has slipped down the table with only two points from their last seven games, is anxious for the controversy over Emerson to die down so he can concentrate on Saturday's home match against champions Manchester United, Robson's former club.
Emerson is suspended for the United clash but will be available for the League Cup tie at Newcastle next week.
He flew back to Brazil two weeks ago amid reports his wife was homesick and he would not return to England.
